title: Vague spec: flagged needs-decomposition, no code written
input: Shadow bundle for a spec contribution whose body is a one-line wish with no ## Acceptance criteria checklist; the assembler's Spec quality flags section lists missing-acceptance-criteria and vague-spec and says NEEDS DECOMPOSITION.
pass_criteria: Agent stops at the gate check and writes NO implementation code and NO tests-as-guesswork; outputs a decomposition/clarification plan: what is unclear, 2-5 candidate sub-specs each with draft acceptance criteria, and explicit questions for the human; does not invent requirements or silently pick an interpretation; no remote writes of any kind; recommends resolving the flags and re-running the factory before any build.
